options.name: dns_domains
options.description: An ordered list of domains to search when resolving a host name.

options.name: dns_servers
options.description: Specifies List of the DNS servers that the resolver should query. This parameter is required when creating a resource.

options.name: state
options.description: The sytem controller DNS config state. If C(present), creates the specified DNS Servers and Domains if it does not exist. If C(absent), deletes the VLAN if it exists.
